## Requirement

Requirement or task ID:

## Change

Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome and the boundaries kept unchanged.

## Test Evidence

List the exact local commands and relevant CI run links.

## Security

Describe dependency, secret, container, data, permission, or release impact. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Residual Risk

Record unresolved risk, operational follow-up, or `None`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change maps to an approved requirement or task.
- [ ] Required tests and generated-artifact drift checks pass.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior and workflow permissions were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the canonical current behavior.
